# Chalkboard

> Chalkboard is a learning company in Bengaluru, India. It runs small-batch school tuitions, interactive corporate training and placement programmes for colleges.

## Chalkboard Tuitions
Grew out of Home Tuitions Bangalore, which has taught since 2018.
- [Tuitions](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/tuitions): Daily small-batch tuitions for Grades 1–10 at 2nd Floor, Pooja Arcade, 50/2, Kammanahalli Main Rd, St Thomas Town, Bengaluru 560084 — near Kalyan Nagar, HRBR Layout and Banaswadi. Phone/WhatsApp +91 74114 46381. Maximum 8 students per batch. CBSE, ICSE and Karnataka State Board. Weekday batches, 4 PM to 8 PM. Free demo class.
- [Contact](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/contact): Book a free demo class.

## Chalkboard Learning Studio
Custom training built around what people need to be able to do. Based in Bengaluru, India; delivers on site and online. Six programs run since 2023.
- [Overview](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio): Training for companies and colleges. A diagnosis first, then a design.
- [Training for companies](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/companies): Corporate training in AI at work, sales, customer support and leadership, plus courses built from a company's own material.
- [AI training for teams](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/ai-training): Hands-on generative AI training built on one rule: learners write the first draft themselves, then use AI to refine it.
- [Programs for colleges](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/colleges): Campus recruitment training and industry tracks (SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, cybersecurity, FinTech), run on campus alongside the degree.
- [Custom courses](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/custom-courses): Courses built from a company's own material in the client's authoring tool (Storyline, Rise, Captivate and others), packaged as SCORM or xAPI with learner reporting.
- [Our work](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/work): Six programs since 2023 at East Point College of Management, Bengaluru: placement accelerators (2026), Advanced Excel (2023, 2025, 2026) and cybersecurity (2023). 97% of 77 surveyed learners rated the 2025 Excel program 4 or 5 out of 5.
- [Insights](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/insights): Writing on AI at work, college readiness and course design.
- [Trainers](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/trainers): Freelance trainers, subject experts and facilitators can send their profile.
